description: OpenClaw MCP → AO API smoke cases (Jetson). Prompts hit POST /api/v1/orchestrate.

cases.prompt: List everything in your filesystem workspace with absolute paths. Use the filesystem tools — don't guess. Include AO_MCP_SMOKE.txt if present.
Using openclaw_filesystem MCP tools, list the absolute path {workspace} and report every filename you see including AO_MCP_SMOKE.txt. Do not invent files. Reply with absolute paths only.
Read the file at absolute path {marker_file} using filesystem tools. Report the exact file contents. Do not invent contents.
Read {workspace}/AGENTS.md with filesystem tools and quote one short line from it. Use the absolute path. Do not guess.
Using the openclaw_bridge MCP, call openclaw_nodes_list and summarize what nodes exist. If none, say none.
